description: This file defines the OpenIdAuthorizationManager class, which manages OpenID authorization objects, providing methods to find by physical ID and retrieve physical IDs, implementing the IOpenIdAuthorizationManager interface.

classes.name: OpenIdAuthorizationManager<TAuthorization>
classes.description: A generic class managing OpenID authorization objects, extending OpenIddictAuthorizationManager and implementing IOpenIdAuthorizationManager.

methods.name: FindByPhysicalIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an authorization by its physical ID, using either the application store or the general store.

methods.name: GetPhysicalIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the physical ID associated with a given authorization.
